The restaurant is very delicious. Enthusiastic staff
Sep 2026 • Solo
I had a very delicious meal and a wonderful experience at the restaurant. Delicious food, rich flavor, just right, the dishes are quite meticulously prepared and beautifully presented. The food is still hot, the quality of the dish is good, and the taste suits me very well. Overall, I am completely satisfied with the food quality here.

The space of the restaurant is clean, cozy, and comfortable, suitable for dining with family, friends, or for meetings and conversations.

I especially want to give praise to the staff member Thu. Thu served very enthusiastically, friendly, and attentive, always cheerfully assisting customers and noticing every small need throughout the meal. Thu's professional and cute service attitude makes me feel very comfortable and have a good impression of the quán.

Delicious food + pleasant atmosphere + enthusiastic staff, especially Thu, created a very memorable experience. I'm sure I will come back to the restaurant in the near future and will introduce it to my friends and relatives to try it.

Thank you to the restaurant and especially thank you to Thu for your enthusiasm and thoughtfulness! ❤️
